name: 이에요/예요
instruction: Saying what or who something is, after a noun ending in a consonant or a vowel.

name: 이/가 아니에요
instruction: Saying something is not a given thing.

name: 있어요/없어요
instruction: Something being somewhere, or someone having or lacking something.

name: 은/는 for the topic
instruction: Introducing what the sentence is about, or contrasting it with something else.

name: 이/가 for the subject
instruction: A subject that is new information, or the subject of 있다, 없다, or an adjective.

name: 을/를 for the object
instruction: A transitive verb with its object stated.

name: 에 for where something is or goes
instruction: Being at a place, or going to one.

name: 에 for time
instruction: An action at a stated time or day.

name: 에서 for where an action happens
instruction: Doing something at a place, as opposed to just being there.

name: 도 for also
instruction: Adding a second item that the same thing applies to.

name: 의, 제, 내 for possession
instruction: One noun owning or belonging to another.

name: 하고 for and with nouns
instruction: Listing two nouns, or doing something with someone.

name: 해요체 present
instruction: A present or habitual action in everyday polite speech.

name: -(스)ㅂ니다 formal style
instruction: Introducing yourself formally, or speaking in a meeting or announcement.

name: -았/었어요 for the past
instruction: A finished action or a past state.

name: -(으)ㄹ 거예요 for plans
instruction: A plan or prediction about the future.

name: -고 있다 for ongoing action
instruction: An action in progress right now.

name: -고 싶다
instruction: Saying what you want to do.

name: 안 for not
instruction: Not doing something by choice, or an adjective that does not hold.

name: 못 for cannot
instruction: Being unable to do something, against choosing not to.

name: -고 for and then
instruction: Two actions or facts joined in one sentence.

name: -지만 for but
instruction: Two clauses that contrast.

name: -(으)세요 for requests
instruction: Politely asking or telling someone to do something.

name: -(으)ㄹ까요? for suggestions
instruction: Suggesting doing something together, or offering to do it.

name: Sino-Korean numbers
instruction: Dates, prices, phone numbers, minutes, or floors.

name: Native numbers with counters
instruction: Counting things, people, or age with a counter.

name: Question words stay in place
instruction: A question with 뭐, 어디, 언제, or 누구.

name: Verb at the end
instruction: Any clause with an object, place, or time before the verb.

name: Set greetings and thanks
instruction: Greeting, thanking, apologising, meeting someone, or saying goodbye.

name: Plain, aspirated, tense consonants
instruction: Words that differ only by a plain, aspirated, or tense consonant.

name: -(으)러 가다 for going to do
instruction: Going or coming somewhere for a purpose.

name: -아서/어서 for a reason
instruction: A cause followed by its result, not a command or suggestion.

name: -아서/어서 for linked steps
instruction: A first action the second depends on, such as going somewhere and then acting there.

name: -(으)니까 for a reason
instruction: A reason followed by a command or suggestion.

name: -(으)면 for if
instruction: A condition and what follows from it.

name: -(으)려고 for in order to
instruction: An action done for a purpose.

name: -는데 for background
instruction: Setting up a situation before a request, contrast, or question.

name: -(으)ㄹ 때 for when
instruction: Something that happens at the time of something else.

name: -기 전에, -(으)ㄴ 후에
instruction: One action before or after another.

name: -(으)ㄴ/-는/-(으)ㄹ before a noun
instruction: A verb describing a noun, with its time shown by the ending.

name: Describing clause before the noun
instruction: A noun described by a whole clause.

name: -(으)ㄹ 수 있다/없다
instruction: Saying someone can or cannot do something.

name: -아야/어야 하다
instruction: Something that has to be done.

name: -(으)ㄹ게요 for promises
instruction: Telling the listener what you will do, for their sake or in reply to them.

name: -아/어 보다 for trying
instruction: Trying something, or suggesting someone try it.

name: -아/어 주다 for doing for someone
instruction: Doing a favour, or asking someone for one.

name: -아/어도 되다 for permission
instruction: Asking or giving permission.

name: -(으)면 안 되다
instruction: Saying something is not allowed.

name: -지요/-죠 for checking
instruction: Seeking agreement on something the speaker assumes.

name: -지 않다
instruction: Negating with the long form, especially on longer verbs or in writing.

name: -지 마세요
instruction: Telling someone politely not to do something.

name: -(으)시- for an honoured subject
instruction: A teacher, parent, elder, or customer as the subject.

name: 드시다, 계시다, 댁, 연세
instruction: An elder eating, being somewhere, or asked their age or home.

name: 반말
instruction: Talking to a close friend, a younger sibling, or a child.

name: 만 for only
instruction: Limiting something to one item.

name: 보다 for comparison
instruction: Comparing two things.

name: (으)로 for direction or means
instruction: Heading toward a place, or doing something with a tool or by a transport.

name: 부터/에서 … 까지
instruction: A range of time or a distance between places.

name: 에게/한테 for to a person
instruction: Giving, telling, or sending something to a person or animal.

name: Hours native, minutes Sino-Korean
instruction: Saying the clock time.

name: -는 것 for doing as a noun
instruction: An activity as the object of 좋아하다, 싫어하다, or as a subject.

name: Irregular stems
instruction: A stem like 덥다, 듣다, 모르다, or 살다 before a vowel ending.

name: -(으)ㄴ 적이 있다/없다
instruction: Saying whether someone has ever done something.

name: Leaving out 저는 and 당신
instruction: A reply or follow-up where the subject is already clear.

name: Reading a reply with gaps
instruction: A short reply whose subject and object come only from context.

name: -기 때문에
instruction: A stated reason, more explicit than -아서.

name: -(으)면서 for while
instruction: Two actions by the same person at the same time.

name: -다가 for switching
instruction: An action interrupted or changed partway.

name: -자마자 for as soon as
instruction: One action right after another.

name: -아/어도 for even if
instruction: A result that holds despite a condition.

name: -게 for so that
instruction: An action done so that something else can happen.

name: -게 되다 for ending up
instruction: A change that came about through circumstance rather than choice.

name: -아/어지다 for becoming
instruction: An adjective describing a change of state.

name: -아/어 있다 for a resulting state
instruction: A state that remains after an action, such as sitting or a door being open.

name: -아/어 놓다/두다 for in advance
instruction: Doing something ahead so its result is ready.

name: -(으)ㄴ/는/(으)ㄹ 것 같다
instruction: A guess, or softening an opinion.
examples: 이 옷이 좀 작은 것 같아요

name: -나 보다, -(으)ㄴ가 보다
instruction: Inferring something from evidence.

name: -기로 하다 for deciding
instruction: A decision or an agreement to do something.

name: -(으)ㄹ 줄 알다/모르다
instruction: Knowing or not knowing how to do something.

name: -잖아요 for you know
instruction: Reminding the listener of something they already know.

name: -거든요 for explaining
instruction: Giving a reason or background the listener did not know.

name: -다고 하다, reported statement
instruction: Reporting what someone said.

name: -냐고 하다, reported question
instruction: Reporting a question someone asked.

name: -(으)라고 하다, reported command
instruction: Reporting a request or order.

name: -자고 하다, reported suggestion
instruction: Reporting a suggestion someone made.

name: -대요, -래요
instruction: Passing on what someone said, in casual speech.

name: -(으)ㄴ지/-는지 + 알다/모르다
instruction: A question embedded as the object of 알다, 모르다, or 궁금하다.

name: 께서, 께
instruction: An elder or superior as the subject, or receiving something.

name: -지 말고
instruction: Telling someone to do one thing instead of another.

name: 처럼, 같이 for like
instruction: Comparing how something is or is done to something else.

name: 마다 for every
instruction: Something that repeats with each unit of time or each member.

name: 밖에 + negative
instruction: Only, stressing that it is less than expected.

name: -(으)ㄴ/는다 written style
instruction: A diary, essay, or report with no listener.

name: 그런데 against 근데
instruction: Starting a sentence with but or so in speech against in writing.

name: Fixed noun + verb pairs
instruction: Catching a cold, taking a photo, or a similar fixed pair.

name: 에 대해(서), 에 대한
instruction: Talking or thinking about a topic.

name: -(으)ㄹ수록 for the more
instruction: One thing increasing with another.

name: -는 바람에
instruction: An unexpected cause with a bad result.

name: -도록 for so that
instruction: A goal or extent the action is aimed at.

name: -더니 for observed change
instruction: Something the speaker saw happen, followed by what came of it.

name: -았/었더니 for after I did
instruction: The speaker's own action and what they then found.

name: -(으)ㄹ 뿐만 아니라
instruction: Adding a second point to a first: not only but also.
examples: 그 식당은 맛있을 뿐만 아니라 값도 싸요

name: -는 김에
instruction: Doing something extra while already doing something else.
examples: 시장에 가는 김에 우유도 사 올게요

name: -다 보면, -다 보니
instruction: A result that comes from doing something repeatedly.
examples: 자꾸 연습하다 보면 잘하게 될 거예요

name: -느라고
instruction: Being kept from something by an activity.

name: -(으)며 in writing
instruction: Joining two facts or simultaneous actions in a report or article.

name: -(으)ㄹ 텐데
instruction: A strong assumption leading into advice, worry, or a wish.

name: -(으)ㄹ 만하다
instruction: Recommending something as worth doing.

name: -(으)ㄴ/는 척하다
instruction: Pretending to do or be something.

name: -(으)ㄹ 뻔하다
instruction: Something that nearly happened.

name: -더라고요 for what I saw
instruction: Reporting something the speaker personally saw or felt.

name: -던데(요)
instruction: A past observation offered as background or mild disagreement.

name: -던 for a past habit
instruction: A noun described by something repeated or unfinished in the past.

name: -았/었었- for a past no longer true
instruction: A past state contrasted with now.

name: Passive -이/히/리/기-
instruction: Something that happens to the subject, such as a door opening or a word being heard.

name: Causative -이/히/리/기/우/구/추-
instruction: Making someone eat, wear, or sleep, or making something lower.

name: -는 데 걸리다/쓰다
instruction: Time or money spent on an activity.
examples: 집에서 회사까지 가는 데 한 시간 걸려요

name: 에 따르면, 에 의하면
instruction: Citing a source such as a forecast or a study.
examples: 일기 예보에 따르면 내일 눈이 온대요

name: -(으)ㄴ/는 탓에
instruction: A cause blamed for a bad result.

name: -(으)ㄴ/는 반면에
instruction: Two opposing sides of one thing.
examples: 이 집은 넓은 반면에 교통이 불편해요

name: -다시피
instruction: Pointing to something the listener already knows or can see.

name: -(으)ㄴ/는 데다가
instruction: Piling one fact on top of another.

name: -(으)ㄴ/는 이상
instruction: A fact already settled that forces a conclusion.

name: -아/어서 그런지
instruction: A possible but uncertain reason.

name: -(으)므로 in writing
instruction: A formal reason in a report, notice, or argument.

name: -고자 in writing
instruction: A stated purpose in a formal speech or document.

name: -기 마련이다
instruction: Something that naturally always happens.

name: -는 셈이다
instruction: Something that amounts to being the case, all things considered.

name: -기 십상이다
instruction: A bad outcome that is very likely.

name: -(으)ㄹ 뿐이다
instruction: Nothing more than this.

name: -(으)ㄴ/는 듯하다
instruction: A hedged guess in writing or formal speech.

name: -고 말다 for in the end
instruction: Something that finally happened, often against wishes.

name: 조차, 마저
instruction: Even this, usually in a bad situation.

name: 은/는커녕
instruction: Not only not the big thing, but not even the small one.

name: -(으)ㅁ in notes and notices
instruction: A memo, notice, or form with clipped endings.

name: 및, 등, 또는
instruction: Listing items in a report or official text.

name: (으)로 인해
instruction: A formal cause in news or reports.

name: -(으)ㄹ망정
instruction: Accepting a hardship rather than giving in.

name: -(으)ㄴ 나머지
instruction: An excess of a feeling or action causing a bad result.
examples: 너무 긴장한 나머지 말을 못 했어요

name: -아/어 봤자
instruction: Saying an action would be pointless.
examples: 지금 가 봤자 문 닫았을 거예요

name: -(으)ㄹ 바에야
instruction: Choosing one bad option over a worse one.

name: -(으)ㄴ/는 마당에
instruction: A situation already reached that changes what makes sense.
examples: 이렇게 된 마당에 숨길 필요 없어요

name: -다 못해
instruction: A state pushed past its limit.

name: -거니와 in writing
instruction: Granting one point while adding a stronger one.

name: -(으)ㄹ지언정 in writing
instruction: A firm stance kept even at a cost.

name: -(으)ㄹ 따름이다
instruction: A formal statement that this is all there is, often in thanks.

name: -기 나름이다
instruction: An outcome depending entirely on how something is done.

name: -(으)ㄹ 법하다
instruction: Something likely or understandable given the situation.

name: -는 둥 마는 둥
instruction: Doing something half-heartedly.
examples: 아침을 먹는 둥 마는 둥 하고 나갔어요

name: -는 바와 같이
instruction: Referring back to something already stated, in formal text.
examples: 앞에서 살펴본 바와 같이 문제가 많다
